content: Footnote 99: there may have been a formal inquisitorial body for heterodoxy charges; Muḥammad Ṭūsī (writing for Bāysunghur) refers to a majlis-i tafaḥḥuṣ u dīvān-i tajassus that interrogated Hurufis, and the dissertation says this was presumably the same institution that conducted Ibn Turka's three trials.
